basic_details.job_title: Calicut University Special Educator Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: One post of Special Educator (on contractual basis) is open at the Community Based Disability Management and Rehabilitation Programme (CDMRP), Department of Psychology, University of Calicut. Applications on plain paper must reach the Director-CDMRP, Department of Psychology, Calicut University-PO, Pin-673635 on or before 06 December 2026 (4 pm). The post carries a consolidated pay of Rs. 32,500/- per month and requires a D.Ed. in Special Education (ID/ASD).

content_sections.heading: About Calicut University CDMRP
content_sections.text: The Community Based Disability Management and Rehabilitation Programme (CDMRP) is a joint project of the Department of Psychology, University of Calicut and the Social Justice Department, Govt. of Kerala. The Special Educator vacancy is in CDMRP Calicut University under the Prachodanam Project, which the notice shows as running up to March 2027. The vacancy notification is dated 24 November 2026 and is signed by the Director, CDMRP, Department of Psychology, University of Calicut.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application is written on plain paper giving full bio-data. It should reach the following address on or before 06 December 2026, 4 pm: Director-CDMRP, Department of Psychology, Calicut University-PO, Pin-673635 The notice says applications "should reach" this address by the deadline, so the date is for receipt, not dispatch. The notice does not mention a postal mode (speed post, registered post or by hand), a prescribed application form or any text to be written on the envelope.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice advertises a single post, Special Educator, with one vacancy at CDMRP Calicut University under the Prachodanam Project. Essential qualification: D.Ed. in Special Education (ID/ASD). Desirable qualification: 5 Years of experience in Developmental Disability Management and Rehabilitation Centers. This experience is listed as desirable, not essential. Mode of appointment: Contract. Project period: Prachodanam Project (up to March 2027). Consolidated pay: Rs. 32,500/- P.M. The age limit is not specified in the notice, and no allowances are mentioned beyond the consolidated pay. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility for the post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Full bio-data on plain paper Passport size attested photograph Attested copies of mark sheets Attested copies of certificates Other necessary documents

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: All applications will be processed by the Director-CDMRP. The shortlisted candidates will be called for interview before the selection committee. The notice does not give an interview date or venue; only shortlisted candidates are called.

faq.question: Q1. How many Special Educator vacancies are there at Calicut University CDMRP?
faq.answer: There is One (1) vacancy of Special Educator at CDMRP Calicut University under the Prachodanam Project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the Calicut University Special Educator post?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the Director-CDMRP on or before 06 December 2026 (4 pm).

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the Special Educator post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is D.Ed. in Special Education (ID/ASD).

faq.question: Q4. Is experience required for the Calicut University Special Educator post?
faq.answer: 5 Years of experience in Developmental Disability Management and Rehabilitation Centers is listed as a desirable qualification, not an essential one.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the Calicut University Special Educator?
faq.answer: The consolidated pay is Rs. 32,500/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the CDMRP Special Educator post?
faq.answer: Send an application on plain paper with full bio-data, a passport size attested photograph and attested copies of mark sheets, certificates and other necessary documents so that it reaches the Director-CDMRP, Department of Psychology, Calicut University-PO, Pin-673635 by 06 December 2026, 4 pm.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Special Educator post?
faq.answer: The Director-CDMRP processes all applications, and the shortlisted candidates are called for interview before the selection committee.

faq.question: Q8. Is the Calicut University Special Educator job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the mode of appointment is Contract, and the post is under the Prachodanam Project (up to March 2027).
